title: Standing Orders
summary: Found your guild. Complete these five steps in order. Until you finish, time does not pass, your campus is closed, and most places on the map cannot be used.

objectives.text: Light the castle at the Grand Hall and take it out through the gate
objectives.doneText: A fire: the castle is lit and out of the gate

objectives.text: Take back the Academy's field store to refuel the castle
objectives.doneText: Provisions: the castle is fueled for the road
A quorum: three members on the roll

objectives.text: Reach the Academy's field house and set your campus door there
objectives.doneText: A doorway: the door is set

objectives.text: Adopt the Standing Orders in the Grand Hall to finish founding the guild
